title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: per-container cap on the amount of a notice
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes when the amount of a notice of loss is held to the product's maximum settlement per container.

## Rule

1. When the product's maximum settlement per container is above 0.00 and the container value exceeds it, the notice carries the maximum settlement per container instead of the container value.
2. Otherwise the notice carries the container value.
3. The amount carried is rounded to the cent.

## Truth table

| Product's maximum per container above 0.00 | Container value exceeds it | Amount carried |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The maximum settlement per container |
| Yes | No | The container value |
| No (0.00) | not compared | The container value |

## Hypothetical worked examples

With a hypothetical maximum per container of 40,000.00 USD: a container value of 62,500.00 gives 40,000.00; a container value of 12,857.14 gives 12,857.14; a container value of exactly 40,000.00 does not exceed the maximum and is carried as 40,000.00. Under a product whose maximum per container is 0.00, a container value of 62,500.00 is carried as 62,500.00.
